site.descricao: Mateus Fabro, data & analytics engineer in Londrina, Brazil: pipelines, anti-fraud, media attribution and his own products in Python, SQL and TypeScript.

perfil.subtitulo: I build the pipeline and the product around it — Python · SQL · TypeScript · AI agents
perfil.tese: I build systems that read public sources and production databases and turn them into alerts people can trust. When I get something wrong, I publish the correction — and the mistake becomes a written rule and, whenever possible, a test that enforces it.
perfil.frase_hero: I build the pipeline and the product around it: from production databases to the alert, dashboard or SaaS the team uses — Python · SQL · TypeScript · AI agents.
resumo: I worked with data in iGaming from October 2025 to November 2026, when the operation shut down: three operations, three countries and three currencies. I was the data lead for two of them — pipelines, the consumer layer of a data lake migration, anti-fraud, media attribution and dashboards.

Outside work, I built my own products and run the ones that are live: an alert service for physicians' public-sector job calls (PR and SP), a café management system with a real customer in production, a clinic SaaS, a group-buying platform, an AI photo app, five content portals fed by official data and a credit SaaS under NDA.

I work paired with AI agents (Claude Code) and with a memory system of my own: every fixed mistake that applies to another project becomes a lesson with an origin, a reason and a way to apply it — and a script proves the index forgot none.

pilares.texto: Pipelines, data lake migration, anti-fraud and media attribution for operations across countries and currencies. Fail-closed by default: a source that is down becomes a known state, never a false zero.

Data only counts when it becomes something people use: a bot, a SaaS, a dashboard, a printed receipt. I build and run my own products with real customers, tested, with an honest status, even the ones that stopped.

Agents with a role, not autonomy: what a reviewer finds is reproduced before it becomes a change. Every fixed mistake becomes a lesson with an origin and a way to apply it, and a script proves the index forgot none.

retificacoes.leia_se: The checker let 3 of 7 reversions of the bug slip through. Since then, every important test is proven by mutation: I revert the fix in a copy and require the suite to go red.
retificacoes.regra: Mutation testing: prove the test can fail

retificacoes.leia_se: A UNIQUE constraint made the zero mandatory: the control just repeated the schema. The case that could actually happen was not being measured — and it had candidates.
retificacoes.regra: A control with a forced result is not a control

retificacoes.contexto: One exchange with the infrastructure team
retificacoes.onde_se_le: Six statements, each backed by a query.
retificacoes.leia_se: Six wrong statements. No query was wrong: in every one, the sentence claimed more than the predicate measured. The person on the other side was right on the detail every single time.
retificacoes.regra: The conclusion cannot be wider than the test

retificacoes.leia_se: The paper said "Seu tem R$ 29,00 de crédito" (roughly "Mr has … in credit"): the code cut the name at the first space, and at a Brazilian café half the regulars are "Seu" or "Dona" somebody. Only printing the real artifact caught it.
retificacoes.regra: Render the artifact the user receives

retificacoes.leia_se: The bot's webhook started getting 308 and the bot went silent for 3h30. The API route left the redirect, a test reads the configuration and a sentinel watches for silence.

retificacoes.onde_se_le: We don't watch your city yet.
retificacoes.leia_se: We watched 192; production saw 11. The canonical list lived in a git-ignored folder that only existed on my machine.
retificacoes.regra: Reference data lives with the code, not in the ignored folder

retificacoes.onde_se_le: Backfill in 7-day slices, one per night in the cloud, until complete.
retificacoes.leia_se: Slices were computed from today, so their edges moved one day per day: 0 of 13 slices in common between two consecutive days. The step timed out without ever saving progress — about 30% of the monthly CI allowance spent on work that could never finish.
retificacoes.regra: Progress only persists if its key is stable over time

retificacoes.onde_se_le: If a gazette platform goes down entirely, the dashboard names it.
retificacoes.leia_se: The adapter swallowed the failure and returned an empty list: the five cities looked alive, and the alarm would never fire in the one case it was built for. The dashboard also filtered out the platform name. Found in a review of what I myself had shipped four days earlier.
retificacoes.regra: An exception path only exists if it is exercised on purpose

retificacoes.contexto: This site, the day before going live
retificacoes.leia_se: 820 of my commits across five products. The four added up to 827 — the 847 included a fifth — and 27 came from the publishing bot. The test that sums the projects caught the first mistake; the fact-check caught the second.
retificacoes.regra: A number outside the code ages on its own

atos.titulo: Verify before concluding
atos.texto: Never say "done" without running the check and reading its output. Green applies only to the exact tree tested: editing afterwards voids the run.

atos.titulo: Mutation testing: prove the test can fail
atos.texto: A green test is worth something only if it could be red. Revert the fix in a copy and require the suite to fail.

atos.titulo: A control with a forced result is not a control
atos.texto: Before publishing "0 occurrences", ask whether the number could have been anything other than zero.

atos.titulo: The conclusion cannot be wider than the test
atos.texto: Right query, right number, false sentence. Put the predicate next to the sentence before publishing.

atos.titulo: Missing data is not a statement
atos.texto: An empty list caused by missing coverage becomes "there is nothing" and reassures the person who should act. Separate "there is none" from "I don't know".

atos.titulo: A queue is not a delivery, and a delivery is not a view
atos.texto: Counting the queue table measures what was enqueued, not what happened. As a denominator, it yields a low, plausible number.

atos.titulo: Watch the effect, not only the cause
atos.texto: A cause monitor only catches the failure someone already imagined. An effect monitor is a single one and indifferent to the cause.

atos.titulo: A backup only exists if it restores
atos.texto: A backup never restored is not a backup; a volume or a replica isn't either. Prove the cycle by destroying real data and bringing it back.

atos.titulo: Silent fallback on a critical value
atos.texto: Exchange rate, configuration, version and limits never sit behind a try/except with a default. Failing loudly beats publishing a wrong number.

atos.titulo: A number outside the code ages on its own
atos.texto: Every published number comes out of the code in the same run. Patching a paragraph creates two quantities with the same name.

atos.titulo: "New to us" is not "just happened"
atos.texto: Widening coverage makes history arrive as news. Notify by the date of the event and mark the old ones.

atos.titulo: Render the artifact the user receives
atos.texto: A green suite does not prove the screen or the paper. Render the receipt, PDF or email the person actually gets.

atos.titulo: Reference data lives with the code
atos.texto: A canonical list in a git-ignored folder only exists on the developer's machine; CI and production degrade silently.

atos.titulo: Never analyze on the database that serves the customer
atos.texto: A read query can also take production down. The default is a replica or an analytical database, with an identified session and a timeout.

atos.titulo: Don't clear a suspect with a non-discriminating signal
atos.texto: To claim "not fraud" or "not a regression", run the detector that would find it. A signal the culprit would also show clears no one.

atos.titulo: The PII guard is the leak vector
atos.texto: The list that proves "no personal data in the delivery" is itself personal data. Derive the target at runtime; don't version it.

atos.titulo: Environment identity from configuration, not from data
atos.texto: "Is this production?" is answered by reading the deploy configuration, not by the presence of a row that may have been deleted.

atos.titulo: Escapes don't survive the shell
atos.texto: \b and \n written through a heredoc reach the file as control characters. The terminal hides it; the regex never matches.

atos.titulo: A subagent judges against a snapshot
atos.texto: An agent without live access gets the reasoning right and the fact wrong. In infrastructure that changes weekly, the snapshot ages in days.

atos.titulo: Don't rely on AI alone
atos.texto: Guess before asking for the number. AI speeds things up; the judgment is still mine.

metodo.texto: Every project has a memory index of its live pitfalls. What applies to another project moves up to a global memory: a lesson with an origin, a reason and a way to apply it.

Promoting a lesson means writing it to disk, to the human index and to the machine index. That step failed twice without a symptom; today a script checks all three and has a mode that proves it can go red.
66 of my 717 commits on Avisa Edital record mutation testing: the defect is reintroduced and the test must fail before the fix counts.

metodo.titulo: Agents with a role, not autonomy
metodo.texto: 25 specialized agents (10 from the data squad and 15 general: quality, security, testing, UX, content review, growth) work in parallel. What the reviewers find is reproduced before it becomes a change.
Every project has a resume file the next session reads first: state, the business owner's decisions and open items, with dates.
